prompt: A village up in the jungle canopy, the huts joined by rope bridges.

card.name: Canopy Village

site.text: A village up in the jungle canopy, huts on platforms among the tree crowns, joined by rope bridges

style.text: Rustic jungle huts of wood, bamboo and leaves, with vines, lanterns and rope railings

purpose.text: A home village living in the treetops

card.interpretation: You want a medium village built high in the jungle trees, with huts on platforms joined by rope bridges. I used existing jungle trees where possible rather than reshaping terrain, a rustic wood-and-leaf look, and a home-village purpose with homes, a communal hall, lookout and storage.
assumptions: Needs a jungle area with tall trees; large trees will be used or added if the land is short
Rustic style and home-village purpose chosen since none were given
Rope bridges are treated as connecting paths, not separate buildings

program.notes: Largest platform built around a huge jungle trunk, hub where most rope bridges meet.
Small homes on separate tree platforms, each linked by rope bridge.
Open communal hall with lanterns and a fire pit area.
Perch above the leaves on the tallest tree.
Raised storage for fruit, cocoa and tools; winch and rope lift to the ground.
Herb planters, hanging vines and potions.
Rope and bamboo crafting, trade goods.
